title: RetroAhoy: The Secret of Monkey Island
summary: A roughly 75-minute video essay from Ahoy's RetroAhoy series on the making and history of The Secret of Monkey Island. It covers the small LucasArts team, the game's development and its sequel.
why: Recommended as a well-made documentary-style history that gives context around the game and inspires replays.

quote.text: Do yourself a favor and watch this wonderful video essay historique on The Monkey Island series from Ahoy
